profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at EMC
profile.summary:
Designed and implemented applications and device drivers for Windows, Linux, VxWorks, MOS and RTOS.
Designed and implemented device drivers for new SONET framers, Clock Data recovery, Serializer Deserializer, Ethernet, FDDI, WAN and ATM chips.
Implemented multiple BSP's for VxWorks, MOS and RTOS using Motorola, Intel and MIPS RISC chips.
Seemlessly introduced an object oriented design into an already shipping system with no negative impact to supported features while adding a completely new platform and new features as well as fixing fundamental flaws in the original design.
My education as a hardware engineer and experience as a software engineer gives me a broad system perspective to make products exceed customer expectations.

Specialties: Application and device driver design and development (in almost any environment), board bring up.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Git · Software Development · Agile Methodologies · C++

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed Linux networking code improvements for domain0 and backend connection to guest domains for Xen hypervisor based server virtualization.
Developed Linux and Windows guest domains (domU) front end accelerated virtual network drivers.
Enhanced the disk virtual block device driver (blkfront) to support additional IDE or SCSI ioctl commands.
Enabled IPv6 support in domain0 and improved initialization scripts.
Replaced busybox implementation in domain0 with full versions of the command set.

positions.title: Expert Software Engineer
positions.description: Upgrade the PXIT BERT and PPG product lines after acquisition by Agilent.  Completed development of Windows DLL and GUI applications to control each family of devices and transitioned the products to manufacturing.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Software Development · C++

positions.title: Consulting Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and implement Windows appplications and device drivers for communications test equipment (BERT, Pattern Generator, Synthesizer).
Wrote software architecture document for the BERT product.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Software Development · C++

positions.title: Consulting Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical/project lead and individual contributor for device driver design and development of SONET/SDH and Ethernet-Over-SONET/SDH systems.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Software Development · C++

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented framework for a 1:n redundancy system for the IO processor boards controlled by a fully redundant (1:1) module. 
Specified system architecture (hardware and software) enhancements to facilitate fast switchover of the SONET clock timing sources.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and implement low level device drivers.
Wrote DSP (TI C6201) code and redesigned traffic control hardware interface to optimize performance of the DSP from 420 ns cycle time cell transmission to 185 ns.
Contributed to the system design of the OC192 product.
Implemented VxWorks BSPs for 2 boards and debugged the BSPs and hardware of 4 boards, based on PowerPC processors (604 and 860).
Wrote an Ethernet device driver supporting off the shelf PCI NICs based on the DEC 21x4x family of MAC chips as well as a proprietary design using the 21143.
Modified the low level interface routines for the VxWorks virtual network interface to operate over any shared memory between two processors (in VxWorks if_sm originally only functioned with VME based memory systems).

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
Designed and implemented drivers for network devices on the vnSwitch family of networking products (ATM, FDDI, Ethernet switch-routers).
Wrote the device driver/ microcode compiler for the custom ASIC "bridge on a chip" at the core of the vnSwitch family of networking products including a hash table algorithm to mirror the look up engine for programming the forwarding table.
Assumed diagnostics project lead during the early stages of the project.
Worked closely with the original system architects to ensure that the product met requirements.
Implemented the BSPs for both RTOS and MOS on the vnSwitch products.
Designed and implemented modular diagnostics that ran on any vnSwitch product, detected the interface types present and ran the appropriate test suite for that variant.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote device drivers and diagnostics for all edge devices for an ATM switch incorporating FDDI, WAN (T1/E1), and Ethernet.
By examining timing of the SGS-Thomson MK50H25 WAN controller, I was able to specify a microcode optimization to enable their device to achieve the multi-port throughput we required.

positions.title: Senior Diagnostics Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote device drivers and diagnostics for networking (Ethernet, WAN, FDDI) and terminal server products.
Specified test procedures for manufacturing.
Designed and implemented portable test code based on the microprocessor core memory layout such that only 3 images needed to be maintained for all variants of the product families.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote device drivers and diagnostics for high performance mass storage devices.
Implemented a predictive method (expert system) of identifying faulty media before resulting in lost data allowing FE's to swap out drives and save customers data.
Participated in the design of a family of SCSI RAID drives with scalable performance and reasonable cost.
